title: Two packages that fill the budget
hints: Pattern: hash map. Instead of searching the list for the partner of each size, remember the sizes you have already seen in a dict.
For each size, the partner you need is target - size. Ask the dict whether that value has been seen and at which index.
Check the dict before you store the current size; storing first lets a value pair with itself.
seen.setdefault(size, j) keeps the earliest index for a repeated size; with [4, 4] the pair is (0, 1).
